caption: Roman theatre, Aosta
composition: Roman theatre arches beneath Alpine peaks · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands before the ruined facade of the Roman theatre, its tall arcade with three tiers of arches rising center-left. Alpine peaks close the horizon behind, while the modern town with its church tower spreads on the right. The 07:26 morning is overcast, the light flat and cool on the stone.
